what: Callgrind instruction counts (Ir) of every arm of the expanse-trie Callgrind harnesses and the expanse-capi smoke harness, default features against --features packed-suffix (expanse-trie/packed-suffix for expanse-capi), same commit, same container, same toolchain

host.cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697 v4 @ 2.30GHz, 2 sockets, 72 threads, 90 MiB L3 (2 instances)
host.os: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS host, Linux 5.15; benches run in a Debian 13.7 container
host.role: x86_64 heavy-jobs host; not the reference benchmark host. Callgrind counts are deterministic, so the host choice does not affect a count's variance; absolute counts differ from the CI instruction-counts job (Ubuntu 24.04, valgrind 3.27.1) through libc and valgrind version, and only the default-to-packed deltas are compared here

estimators.instructions: Callgrind Ir per arm as printed by iai-callgrind, exact; deterministic, so no interval and no rounds (AGENTS.md section 8.4)

commands: git archive <commit> | tar -x (tracked files only; no target, no .git)
provenance.build_isolation: one CARGO_TARGET_DIR per build; the two builds ran in two containers at once
provenance.not_run: expanse-capi vs_stock (needs the stock libjudy oracle)

load.note: recorded for completeness; Callgrind counts do not depend on load

disassembly.command: objdump -d -C --no-show-raw-insn <instructions bench binary>; instructions counted per function symbol, '%fs:' operands counted per function
disassembly.binary: target/release/deps/instructions-<hash> of each build (cargo bench profile)
disassembly.note: insert_impl, remove_impl, insert_shared and remove_shared have no out-of-line symbol in either build: each is inlined into its caller. new_suffix has no symbol in the default build

attribution.command: callgrind_annotate --inclusive=no --threshold=100 on each build's callgrind.<arm>.out; per-function Ir, packed_suffix minus default
